# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Be respectful in issues, pull requests, and anywhere else you interact with this project. Harassment, personal attacks, and discriminatory language are not allowed.

Report unacceptable behavior to mmfuad01@gmail.com. Reports are kept confidential. I may edit or remove comments, close issues, or block users who break these rules.
